interpretation.abstract_27_of_144: The abstract gives27/144 for the placebo comparison. The body separates31/144 recording incidence into27placebo and4DPP4 comparisons. This is not a complete per-component,per-arm,dosed-population and observation-window audit.
interpretation.data_route: Primary article,then registry,then corresponding-author inquiry. This audit concerns public reconstructibility; the former review's author-supplied data route is not assumed publicly recoverable.
interpretation.estimands: Prior review:spectrum-composite event incidence/person-time; one person may contribute multiple events. Current audit:people with each component,by original eligible treated arm,modality and fixed planned observation.
interpretation.not_comparable: Do not compare27/144 with audit k/159 or k/182,nor interpret differences as error,underreporting prevalence or a risk difference.
interpretation.novelty: The contribution is the source-to-component-to-arm-to-reference bridge and its explicit limits; it does not claim first evidence that reporting is sparse.
interpretation.systematic_recording_not_structured_scal: Systematic recording in the review abstract is not proof of C-SSRS use or comprehensive structured ascertainment in27trials.
